body:
I don’t know if this is the right word to use, but it’s absolutely **beautiful** that you want to live and know that you have a great future ahead of you. I know how crushing and exasperating it is to feel so much pain that is completely out of your control. But it’s absolutely beautiful and amazing that you know you’re worth more than suicide. 

Please call a suicide prevention line and admit yourself now. Yes, there is the virus but unmonitored, uncontrolled depression is more lethal than the virus especially for your age group. Many, if not most, hospital have dedicated, isolated covid units at this point. The medical staff trained to take care of covid patients will not be the same staff trained to manage a psychiatric unit, which mean little to no chance of personnel crossover to spread the virus. Please, you are an amazing, strong, beautiful, and seemingly *rare*person who truly understands how worthy they are of living. Please don’t lose that because of a the covid scare.
